value.title: First light, live transcript: create worktree of this repo -> edit file -> search finds worktree version from inside + main version from main -> remove worktree -> GC reclaim shown. One transcript, committed as exit evidence.
value.success: Transcript committed; ac-0002/0003/0004 receipts cite it.
value.note: PARTIAL, deliberately. Composed run 20260828T035625Z (private database, fake providers) proved the lifecycle half live: one root registered by hand, TWENTY auto-registered by the detector, ~15k jobs drained at zero spend, p1_auto_discovered 0->1, p1_unchanged_reconcile_jobs=0, p4_root_still_registered 1->0, p4_deleted_content_still_served 1->0, p4_served_after_gc=0, p3_get_context_sensitive=1. The P3 retrieval half is NOT measurable under a fake embedder — a query quoting the marker's own body verbatim scored 0.1889 against unrelated files — and the harness now emits unmeasurable-fake-embedder rather than a misleading zero (af3fa10). Prime ruled the live P3 measurement happens AFTER merge, as the go-live record, because running it is the feature going live for the fleet rather than a test.
